verdict.rationale: OCI documents a Free Trial of $300 in credits valid for up to 30 days. It also documents Always Free offers that never expire and stay available after the trial ends. Community users confirm long-running free ARM instances (4 vCPU / 24 GiB, 10TB bandwidth), but also report that idle Always Free compute is reclaimed after 7 days of low utilization, and some accounts were banned for heavy use. Missing for 10: first-party documentation in the pack of the specific Always Free resource limits and the idle-reclamation rules, and any published startup-credits program.
